description: Everything a Server needs to know before it starts.

acme_directory.description:
The ACME directory a Server Linked to the Hub gets the certificate for its names from
(ADR 0057). Let's Encrypt's by default; its staging one,
`https://acme-staging-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory`, for trying things out.

data_dir.description:
Directory where the Server keeps its database and other state. A relative path counts from
the folder the Server starts in.

ffmpeg.description:
The ffmpeg to run, such as a container's own. Unset, the default, looks for `ffmpeg` on
`PATH`. A bare name, such as `jellyfin-ffmpeg`, is looked up on `PATH`, and a path with a
folder in it, such as `bin/ffmpeg`, counts from the folder the Server starts in.

ffprobe.description:
The ffprobe to run. Unset, the default, looks for `ffprobe` on `PATH`. A bare name is looked
up on `PATH`, and a path with a folder in it, such as `./ffprobe`, counts from the folder
the Server starts in.

forwarded_port.description:
The port on the router's public IP address that the Admin forwards to the Server, for
clients outside the LAN of a Server Linked to the Hub. Unset, the default, has the Server
open one itself with UPnP or NAT-PMP while the Plugin that links it is enabled.

name.description: The Server's display name, which clients show to tell Servers apart.

plugins.description:
The `[plugins.<id>]` tables in the file, imported into the database on the first start and
ignored after.

trusted_proxies.description:
Reverse proxies whose `X-Forwarded-For` and `X-Forwarded-Proto` headers the Server believes.
Empty by default, so the headers are ignored.

items.description: An IP address, or a CIDR range such as `10.0.0.0/8`, written as such in the config.

watch_folders.description:
Whether the OS reports changes in Library folders so they're scanned soon after. On by
default; off, folders are scanned every six hours and when asked.

title: Config
